A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''chieftan''' of the [[Evocii]] [[Species/Legends|species]] lived well before the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] controlled [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], then called Evocar. Two famous Evocii warriors wanted the hand of his eldest child, and they fought a duel of honor for multiple days on a site which would forever be remembered in Evocii history.<ref name="item" />
